headline: Revolut initiates hiring push in Israel following conditional banking license
summary: UK-based digital challenger bank Revolut launched a hiring drive across executive and tech levels in Israel after receiving a conditional operating license from the Bank of Israel.
why: Revolut is one of Europe's highest-valued fintech startups, expanding international retail banking operations.

impacts.name: Revolut
impacts.why: Securing regulatory approval allows expansion into Israeli digital financial services.
